name: GANESWAR BEHERA

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ganeswar Behera is a bilingual poet associated with Jajpur, Odisha, according to his Kabita Live contributor note. His two poems here, ‘Spiral thoughts’ and ‘GINGERY CARE’, explore affection through the unsettled language of longing.

Both poems address an absent or distant beloved. Heartbeats, whispers and imagined embraces become ways of holding a relationship close, even as restless thoughts interrupt that wish. Their short stanzas and intimate forms of address give emotional uncertainty a conversational voice.
